messages.text: Expression and table parity is strong. I’m covering standalone filesystem commands and final entrypoint hygiene.

commands.commandLine:
powershell.exe -Command "Copy-Item .\\main.py .\\executable -Force; @'
import subprocess,pathlib
nu=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); py=['python','executable']
cases=['[{a: 1} {a: 22, b: 3}]','{a: {b: 2}} | get a.b','[a b c] | str join \",\"','\"abc\" | str starts-with a','[1 2] | enumerate','[{a:2} {a:1}] | sort-by a','{a:1} | to json --raw']
for c in cases:
 a=subprocess.run([nu,'--no-config-file','-c',c],capture_output=True); b=subprocess.run(py+['--no-config-file','-c',c],capture_output=True)
 print(('OK ' if (a.returncode,a.stdout,a.stderr)==(b.returncode,b.stdout,b.stderr) else 'BAD'),c)
 if (a.returncode,a.stdout,a.stderr)"'!=(b.returncode,b.stdout,b.stderr):print('"'REF',repr(a.stdout),repr(a.stderr),'GOT',repr(b.stdout),repr(b.stderr))
'@ | python -"
